content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Collector Office Ranipet Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Express willingness in writing using Annexure I and II. Furnish particulars in 6 copies. Enclose two passport size photographs. Send the application to the District Collector Office, Ranipet on or before 28-10-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after 5.45 PM on 28-10-2026 will not be considered.

faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 28 October 2026.

faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure I and II) and send it to District Collector Office, Ranipet, by by hand or post, to reach by 28 October 2026.
